app.label: Disconnect networking
app.detail: Bluetooth, WebRTC peers, signaling and relays are disconnected and all active transfers cancelled.

app.label: Stop background services
app.detail: Background reception and relay participation stop and cannot deliver anything anymore.

app.label: Cancel transfers
app.detail: Active and queued file transfers are cancelled and their partial chunks deleted.

app.label: Erase conversations and messages
app.detail: Every conversation, message, draft, search index, and delivery record is deleted.

app.label: Erase contacts and groups
app.detail: Contacts, trust records, and local group membership and group keys are deleted.

app.label: Erase files and media
app.detail: Downloaded attachments, previews, thumbnails and temporary transfer files are deleted.

app.label: Erase queues and caches
app.detail: Outgoing, incoming and relay store-and-forward queues plus app-managed caches are deleted.

app.label: Erase cryptographic state
app.detail: Identity keys, session keys and all other locally stored secrets are deleted.

app.label: Erase local database
app.detail: The local encrypted database and app-managed temporary files are deleted.

app.label: Erase settings and reset app
app.detail: Application settings are cleared and the app returns to first-run onboarding.

conversation.label: Cancel transfers in this chat
conversation.detail: Active and queued file transfers for this conversation are cancelled.

conversation.label: Erase this chat locally
conversation.detail: Messages, attachments, previews, drafts, queues and delivery records for this conversation are deleted.

conversation.label: Erase chat encryption session
conversation.detail: Only with “Delete chat and local session state”: future messages will require a new secure session handshake.
